items.headline: Texas completes 20-point comeback and stuns No. 1 Ohio State
items.description: Texas completes 20-point comeback and stuns No. 1 Ohio State

items.headline: Arch Manning shares excitement on Texas' stunning win vs. Ohio State
items.description: Manning discusses how the Longhorns were able to come back from a 20-point deficit and gain all their momentum in the fourth quarter to steal the victory against the Buckeyes.

items.headline: No. 4 Texas mounts fourth-quarter rally, stuns No. 1 Ohio State
items.description: Hollywood Smothers scored on a 1-yard run with a leap over the pile with 25 seconds left and No. 4 Texas rallied from 20 points down in the fourth quarter to beat No. 1 Ohio State 24-23 Saturday night.

items.headline: No. 4 Texas stuns No. 1 Ohio State 24-23 after erasing 20-point 4th-quarter deficit
items.description: — Arch Manning and No. 4 Texas stole a 24-23 victory from No. 1 Ohio State on Saturday night, rallying from a 20-point fourth-quarter deficit to win it on Hollywood Smothers’ 1-yard touchdown run with 25 seconds left.

items.headline: Laura Rutledge shouts out her old crew during 'Nation on Location'
items.description: ESPN reporters preview the biggest Week 2 matchups from around the nation as former SEC Nation host Rutledge sends a special message to the team.

items.headline: SEC Nation describes how Ohio State vs. Texas could go
items.description: Paul Finebaum says this top-five matchup is a must-win for Steve Sarkisian while the rest of the SEC Nation crew explains how the Longhorns have to show up against the Buckeyes.
